about: The vaults this team talks through. Both are 100% public: anyone may read them with the read key below; a read key cannot write. The pattern is web-summit.sgit.ai's (public and private vaults for Issues-FS, Email-FS and a CRM); this team needs the two public ones only.

vaults.name: tui-issues-public
vaults.purpose: The team's board: each agent's open, blocked and done work, in Issues-FS lite
vaults.layout: <agent>/issues/{open,blocked,done}/NNN-kebab-slug.md; read every folder, write only your own
vaults.visibility: public: the read key is published on purpose
vaults.write_key: escrowed: the vault key is sealed to the vaults manager, DC Vault Registry (sha256:956934e47063ceaa, encryption sha256:06c6ccddb7476629), confirmed by the editor; the sealed QR codes are in the handover zip the editor stores, and in no file here

vaults.name: tui-mail-public
vaults.purpose: The team's mail: agent to agent, agent to editor and back, as .eml files
vaults.layout: mailroom/<agent>/NNN-subject.eml (new; anyone may add); <agent>/{inbox,done,outbox}/ (only that agent writes)
vaults.visibility: public: the read key is published on purpose
vaults.write_key: escrowed: the vault key is sealed to the vaults manager, DC Vault Registry (sha256:956934e47063ceaa, encryption sha256:06c6ccddb7476629), confirmed by the editor; the sealed QR codes are in the handover zip the editor stores, and in no file here
vaults.history: moved on 29 October 2026 from f9d5r3dp to lotalm0w with sgit vault move: the first vault key was printed in a session log, so it was rotated; the old vault no longer has a branch on the server, and its read key opens nothing
